label: Munsell
source: Munsell renotation data (the 'real' set) as bundled with the colour-science library
licence: BSD-3-Clause, Colour Developers (the library bundling the data)
note: CIE xyY under illuminant C (Y scaled by 0.975), converted to Lab D50 by Bradford. Only samples inside sRGB are kept. The nine neutral steps N1 to N9 are added from the ASTM D1535 value function, because the renotation list has no chroma-0 samples.
